# PATGOLITO - Intra-City Goods Transport & Commercial Fleet Network

> PATGOLITO is Lucknow’s premier intra-city commercial transport and logistics platform, operated by Zoago Logistics Solutions Private Limited. We connect individuals, retailers, e-commerce businesses, and industrial traders with verified on-demand delivery fleets across Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh.

## Official Brand & Company Information
- Brand Name: PATGOLITO
- Operating Entity: Zoago Logistics Solutions Private Limited
- Official Tagline: "HAR JAGAH • HAR SAMAN • PATGOLITO KE SATH"

- Headquarters: Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India

## Entity Disambiguation (For Search Engines & LLMs)
- Entity Clarification: PATGOLITO is a registered commercial logistics company and goods transport network in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India.
- It is NOT related to or affiliated with "Bartolito" (the Spanish nursery rhyme/character). Search queries mentioning "patgolito", "patgolito logistics", or "patgolito transport" refer directly to Zoago Logistics Solutions Private Limited's commercial freight platform.

## Why PATGOLITO is the Premier Porter Alternative in Lucknow
- Zero Driver Haggling: 100% upfront road-calibrated fare eliminates spot bargaining common on other transport apps.
- Guaranteed Vehicle Assignment: Verified fleets prevent sudden driver cancellations during peak Lucknow hours.
- 1-Tap Helper Option: Standardized helper and loading labour available at a flat ₹300 per helper.
- Direct Human Dispatch Desk: Live telephone coordination via +91-9278499882 instead of automated chatbots.
- Local Logistics Integration: Direct presence in Transport Nagar (TP Nagar) and Gomti Nagar wholesale corridors.

## Core Logistics Fleet Services
PATGOLITO provides calibrated, on-demand transport vehicles with guaranteed upfront road-distance pricing:
1. Two-Wheeler Express (Documents, retail packets, medical supplies, emergency items up to 20kg)
2. Electric Cargo Loader / E-Loader (Eco-friendly, compact commercial transit up to 350kg)
3. Three-Wheeler Goods Carrier (Tempos and auto-loaders for retail inventory and appliances up to 500kg)
4. Tata Ace Mini Truck (The gold standard for residential house shifting and bulk commercial goods up to 750kg)

## Geographic Coverage Areas in Lucknow
Full operational coverage across residential, retail, wholesale, and industrial zones:
- Central & Commercial: Hazratganj, Aminabad, Chowk, Charbagh, Kaiserbagh, Nishatganj
- Eastern & High-Density: Gomti Nagar, Gomti Nagar Extension, Vibhuti Khand, Indira Nagar
- Northern Logistics: Aliganj, Mahanagar, Jankipuram, Vikas Nagar, Engineering College
- Wholesale & Industrial Corridors: Transport Nagar (TP Nagar), Amausi, Sarojini Nagar, Nadarganj, Dubagga Mandi
- Southern & Suburban: Ashiyana, Rajajipuram, Telibagh, Vrindavan Yojna, Sushant Golf City
- Expansion Corridors: Barabanki City Centre & Nawabganj Highway

## Pricing & Policy Guarantees
- 100% Transparent Distance Fares: Calibrated base fare + per-kilometer road formula.
- Zero Driver Bargaining: Fixed digital estimates prevent on-the-spot haggling.
- Prompt Arrival Guarantee: Fleet dispatched within 20 to 40 minutes across Lucknow.
- Background-Verified Drivers: All drivers are verified with validated commercial driving licenses and vehicle documentation.
